_comment: Rules for the workspace pre-publish audit, run against whatever ref is about to be pushed:
`deny` holds strings the built-in patterns cannot know about, because they look like ordinary
words to a generic scanner. Every entry below was a real occurrence in this repository.
Each pattern is written with a character class around one letter so that this file does not
itself contain the literal string it is looking for.
`allow` holds the expected placeholders, each with a reason. Loosening a pattern to silence a
finding is how the next real one gets through.

deny.why: the real provider brand host. 46 occurrences across 6 tracked files were replaced with provider.tv on 2026-08-01
the provider's real CDN host labels, in URL or prose form
the real M3U account name suffixes. Each is three characters and means nothing to a generic scanner, which is the whole reason this list exists
this machine's Windows drive mapping of the container volumes. It was in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md and already published before it was noticed
an internal backup location, not a path any user of this plugin has
the operator's personal account name, which appears in notification settings

allow.reason: the placeholder that replaced the real provider brand host. The .tv top level domain is preserved deliberately: a previous substitution to .example silently disabled a test gated on a TLD allowlist containing .tv
the placeholder form of an M3U account name in test fixtures. The real suffixes are in the deny list
an obviously fake token in tests/test_settings_intro.py, proving the bug report file masks a secret rather than printing it
a fake credential-bearing URL in tests/test_reports_sanitise.py, proving an unknown key is dropped from the emailed report
the reserved documentation address ranges, used in tests proving an address is scrubbed out of a report. These cannot be anyone's real network
the reserved IPv6 documentation range and a link-local example, used in the test proving IPv6 is scrubbed
named in .gitignore so the notes files are never published, and referenced in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md as where contributors keep working notes. The files themselves are not tracked
a gitignore entry for a local planning directory, not a published path
